review_candidates.title: Partnership Finance Assistant
review_candidates.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. This position is open to Ukrainian nationals only. The monthly salary is UAH 54,000 gross (before taxes). The position will be based in the Mykolaiv / Kherson Field Office, Ukraine IRC Ukraine is recruiting this position to support the implementation of a UHF/OCHA-funded project in the South of Ukraine, covering Khersonska and Mykolaivska Oblasts, delivered by IRC together with sub-implementing partners. The Partnership Finance Assistant provides day-to-day finance support for the management and oversight of partner financial documentation, assisting in the review of partner financial reports, verification of supporting documentation and cost eligibility, and the maintenance of complete and audit-ready partner financial records. The position works under the supervision of the Finance & Compliance Manager and in close coordination with IRC Finance, Grants and Partnerships colleagues. It is a support role: partner organizations retain responsibility for their own financial management and internal controls, and the position contributes to helping partners meet donor requirements rather than performing a control or enforcement function. The position will be based in the Mykolaiv / Kherson Field Office, Ukraine, with regular travel to project and partner locations within Khersonska and Mykolaivska Oblasts as required. Given the frontline operating context, the position is subject to the applicable Duty of Care and security management arrangements. Key Responsibilities Partner financial report review and verification: Support the review of financial reports submitted by sub-implementing partners, checking arithmetical accuracy, completeness and consistency with the approved partner budget. Compare reported expenditure against approved budget lines and flag variances, unbudgeted items or amounts exceeding agreed thresholds for the attention of the Finance & Compliance Manager. Support the review of partner cash requests and liquidation documentation, and assist in tracking advances issued, amounts liquidated and outstanding balances. Prepare review checklists, summaries of observations and follow-up lists for each partner reporting cycle. Assist in reconciling partner financial reports with disbursement records and with the consolidated project financial information. Work with the internal ERP system (posting transactions, settlements, reconciliations, etc.). Supporting Documentation And Cost Eligibility Verify that partner expenditure is supported by complete documentation, including invoices, receipts, delivery notes, payment vouchers, proof of payment and evidence of receipt of goods or services. Support the review of procurement documentation for partner expenditure, including quotations, bid analysis, purchase orders and contracts, and flag missing or inconsistent documents. Assist in checking that costs are eligible under the grant agreement and donor rules, and flag items that appear ineligible, insufficiently documented or outside the approved implementation period. Identify and flag potential duplicate payments, split purchases, amounts that do not match supporting documents, and other inconsistencies requiring clarification. Prepare clear, factual queries for partners on missing or unclear documentation and track responses through to resolution. Ukrainian Statutory And Payroll Compliance Support Verify that partner payroll costs are supported by appropriate documentation, including timesheets, payroll registers and wage accrual statements. Check that payroll-related statutory obligations, including personal income tax, military levy and unified social contribution, are reflected in partner budgets and reports and supported by corresponding bank payment confirmations. Flag discrepancies between budgeted and reported statutory payroll costs for review by the Finance & Compliance Manager. Maintain an organised record of partner statutory payment evidence for each reporting period. UHF/OCHA Donor Requirements And Reporting Support Maintain working familiarity with the applicable UHF/OCHA financial requirements, including cost-eligibility rules, documentation standards, Programme Support Costs and the applicable cost structure, and apply these in day-to-day review work. Support the preparation of donor financial reporting inputs, cost breakdowns and bills of quantities for partner expenditure. Assist in assembling partner financial documentation required for UHF/OCHA financial spot checks, monitoring visits and audits. Support the maintenance of a calendar of partner financial reporting deadlines and follow up with partners to promote timely submission. Partner Monitoring And Capacity-building Support Participate in partner financial monitoring visits, supporting the verification of supporting documentation, filing systems and record keeping at partner premises. Prepare documentation and sample selections in advance of monitoring visits, and support the drafting of visit notes and follow-up action lists. Support the delivery of finance training, coaching and on-the-job guidance for partner finance staff on documentation, reporting templates and donor requirements. Track agreed follow-up actions arising from monitoring visits and reporting reviews, and support confirmation that improvements have been applied in subsequent submissions. Support partners in a constructive, respectful manner, recognising that strengthening partner capacity is part of IRC's responsibility for the proper use of donor funds. Record Keeping, Filing And Audit Readiness Maintain complete, well-organised and retrievable partner financial files, both electronic and hard copy, in line with IRC filing standards and donor retention requirements. Ensure that each partner payment is supported by a complete, traceable documentation set that can be located quickly for audit or spot-check purposes. Support preparation of schedules, samples and supporting documentation requested by internal and external auditors. Maintain trackers of partner reports received, reviews completed, queries raised and issues resolved. Risk Awareness And Escalation Promptly bring documentation gaps, unexplained discrepancies and possible non-compliance to the attention of the Finance & Compliance Manager. Immediately report any suspicion of fraud, corruption or misuse of funds through the appropriate IRC reporting channels, without discussing the matter with the partner concerned. Handle partner and project financial information with confidentiality, accuracy and integrity at all times. General Duties Comply with all IRC policies, procedures and guidelines, including any new procedures or principles issued by the Country Director, Deputy Director for Finance or other designated authority. Act at all times in accordance with Ukrainian law and applicable standards of accounting practice. Maintain strict confidentiality of all financial and other work-related information. Be receptive to training provided and actively develop own technical and professional competence. Report any irregularities, security concerns or breaches of policy and procedure to the supervisor and through the appropriate IRC channels. Carry out any other duties as may be assigned by the supervisor or management. Education JOB REQUIREMENTS University degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics or a related discipline; or equivalent relevant practical experience. Experience Typically 2+ years of relevant finance, accounting or finance-administration experience, preferably in an NGO or donor-funded environment. Experience reviewing financial documentation and supporting evidence for accuracy, completeness and compliance with established requirements. Working knowledge of Ukrainian payroll-related statutory obligations, including personal income tax, military levy and unified social contribution, is highly desirable. Exposure to donor-funded award requirements; familiarity with UHF/OCHA or other pooled fund requirements is an advantage. Experience working with local partner or sub-award financial documentation is an advantage. Demonstrated Skills And Competencies Strong spreadsheet skills, particularly Excel, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain orderly, retrievable records. Fluency in Ukrainian required; good written and spoken English required. Ability to work respectfully and constructively with partner organizations, with sound judgement in handling confidential financial information. Key Competencies Accuracy and attention to detail Organisation, timeliness and follow-through Service-oriented support to partners and colleagues Integrity, discretion and confidentiality Willingness to learn and apply donor requirements Clear communication and collaboration REPORTING STRUCTURE AND TEAM COLLABORATION Position reports to: Finance & Compliance Manager – South Response Other internal contacts: IRC Finance team; Grants; Partnerships; Supply Chain; Program and Operations teams in the Mykolaiv / Kherson Field Office. Key external contacts: Sub-implementing partner finance staff, as coordinated through the Finance and Compliance Manager; auditors and service providers as relevant. Work Environment And Other Relevant Information This role requires full-time work in the office or hybrid type of work is possible after probation period Applicants must have a home or alternate workspace so they can effectively complete their work during regularly scheduled work hours. Travel to other locations is needed up to 30% of time Exempt from overtime Sometimes work on weekends may be required Work in the matrix organization Fast pace of working, multitasking and stressful work The organization cares about staff and provides flexible working options (start early-finish early, start later-finish later, remote work) This position will be based in the Mykolaiv / Kherson Field Office, with regular travel to project and partner locations within Khersonska and Mykolaivska Oblasts as necessary. Given the frontline operating context, the position is subject to the applicable Duty of Care and security management arrangements. IRC Employees Are Eligible To The Following Benefits Competitive salary Purposeful job and development opportunities English classes and unlimited online training courses Life Insurance Medical insurance for staff and family members Free psychological support to employees and their family members 30 calendar days of annual vacation with flexibility beyond the legally set minimum requirements Up to 10 days of paid medical leave Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients. review_candidates.title: NHL, Youtube Account Manager
review_candidates.description: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality. IMG Digital is a digital sports agency and consultancy within IMG. The team works with sports teams, leagues, federations and governing bodies to create and execute digital strategy, produce engaging content, run social media channels and deliver owned-platform activity. The work is focused on helping sports properties reach new audiences, build stronger relationships with fans and generate value from their intellectual property. IMG Digital is looking for an Account Manager to support the NHL’s YouTube and social media operation across its two channels, NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland. The role will be based in Germany and will take day-to-day ownership of the planning, production, publishing and optimisation of content for NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland audiences. This is a hands-on account management role for someone who understands how to build audiences on YouTube, package content for performance and manage delivery across a busy international sports calendar. The successful candidate will work closely with the NHL, IMG Digital colleagues, paid media specialists, creators, production partners and wider market teams. The role requires a flexible approach to working hours. NHL content and audience activity often peak around games, live events and key publishing windows, so the role will include planned availability across some weekends, early mornings and evenings. Working patterns will be agreed in advance wherever possible, with a focus on fair planning and appropriate time back where required. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities Own the day-to-day relationship and workflow for the NHL’s two YouTube and social channels, covering NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland, working as a trusted contact for internal and external stakeholders. Develop and manage YouTube content plans across NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland around the NHL season, live games, tentpole moments, Global Series activity, local market priorities and relevant cultural opportunities. Lead the content posting and publication process across both YouTube channels, including content planning, scheduling, publishing, metadata, titles, descriptions, playlists, thumbnails, end screens and other platform features. Own community management across the YouTube channels in German and English, including comments, posts and wider YouTube community areas, responding to audiences and identifying useful feedback and insights. Work with NHL.com International teams to coordinate edits, content production, approvals and publishing requirements across the NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland operation. Apply a strong understanding of YouTube audience behaviour, search, recommendations, retention, watch time, click-through rate and other relevant performance signals. Work with editors, designers, producers, creators and localisation partners to brief, review and deliver high-quality European- and German-language content. Adapt international NHL content for German and European audiences while maintaining accuracy, tone of voice, brand standards and platform best practice. Manage publishing calendars and approvals, ensuring content is delivered accurately and on time across planned and reactive moments. Monitor channel and content performance through YouTube Studio and other reporting tools, identifying clear actions to improve reach, engagement, retention and audience growth. Produce regular performance updates and turn data into practical recommendations for the NHL and IMG Digital teams. Support the development of repeatable formats, series and programming approaches that can grow the NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland audiences on YouTube over time. Coordinate with wider NHL international social/editorial and domestic NHL YouTube teams to share learnings, align campaigns and identify opportunities to reuse or localise content across platforms. Maintain clear documentation of content plans, approvals, publishing decisions, performance results and key learnings. Support live and near-live content activity when required, including planned coverage around games, events and major NHL announcements. Support paid media and YouTube promotion activity across both channels, working with paid media specialists to brief, activate, optimise and evaluate campaigns. Lead regular reporting across organic and paid activity, turning channel performance, audience data and campaign results into clear recommendations for the NHL and IMG Digital teams. Contribute directly to content creation, including concepts, scripts, copy, briefs, thumbnails and basic video editing where required. Knowledge and Experience Proven experience managing or growing a YouTube channel, ideally for a sports, media, entertainment brand. Strong practical knowledge of YouTube Studio, YouTube Analytics, channel publishing and content optimisation. Experience developing content plans and managing delivery from brief through to publishing and reporting. Native-level German and strong written and spoken English. A clear understanding of what makes video content discoverable, clickable, watchable and shareable on YouTube. Experience using audience and performance data to improve content decisions and demonstrate results. Strong account management and stakeholder communication skills, with the confidence to manage multiple contributors and deadlines. Excellent organisation and attention to detail, particularly around publishing, approvals, rights, metadata and localisation. A genuine interest in the NHL, ice hockey, sports media and the behaviour of German-speaking audiences. Willingness and ability to work flexibly around live sport, including some weekends, early mornings and evenings. Skills and Abilities Strong initiative and a practical, can-do approach to delivery. Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise, manage deadlines and remain calm under pressure. Analytical and curious, with the ability to turn performance data into clear actions. High attention to detail across content, publishing, rights, localisation and reporting. Collaborative and generous with knowledge, with a willingness to support colleagues and share learnings. Comfortable balancing creative judgement, platform expertise, audience insight and operational detail. Desirable experience Experience working with an international sports rights-holder, league, team, broadcaster, publisher or agency. Experience with German sports audiences or German-language digital content. Experience developing YouTube Shorts, long-form video, live content, compilations or recurring programming formats. Familiarity with thumbnail development, video packaging, basic editing workflows and creative testing. Experience managing creators, freelancers, production partners or localisation suppliers. Knowledge of other social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. Experience working across multiple markets, languages or time zones. Experience in paid media, including campaign briefing, audience targeting, optimisation and evaluation. Strong reporting experience across organic and paid activity, with confidence presenting insights and recommendations. Content creation and editing expertise, including copywriting, scripting, basic video editing, thumbnails and platform packaging. Experience supporting live streams, live or near-live publishing and work with hosts, presenters or on-camera talent. Success Measures Consistent, accurate and timely leadership of content posting, publication and community management across the NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland YouTube channels. Growth in relevant German-speaking reach, engagement, watch time, retention and returning audience behaviour. Clear evidence that performance data is being used to improve content planning, packaging and programming. Strong relationships with the NHL, IMG Digital colleagues, creators and production partners. A reliable and well-organised operating rhythm around games, live events and key NHL moments. Development of scalable content formats and repeatable approaches that strengthen the NHL’s presence on YouTube across NHL Europe and NHL Deutschland. In addition, success at IMG is driven by four core competencies that apply to all employees: Business Acumen – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes Operational Excellence – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations Innovation Mindset – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development Leadership & Collaboration – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams Working Conditions This is a permanent position Working hours are 9:00 – 17:00, Monday to Friday This is a remote position based in Germany. Expected to provide support out of usual working hours at times as Executives travel or attend events Adapting to use of new systems and technology where appropriate German language fluency essential

review_candidates.title: Minor New Works Planner
review_candidates.description: Salary: Competitive + Excellent Benefits Location: Remote / Home based The role: OPA are looking to appoint a Minor New Works Planner to take full responsibility for the capture, development, planning, scheduling, monitoring, and control of all planning activities associated with Minor New Works projects across the Oil and Pipelines managed estate. This includes coordinating and developing planned job packages, ensuring effective resource allocation, and maintaining robust project schedules to support the successful delivery of engineering works. This newly created role will take full responsibility for the planning of OPA's assurance programme and improvement works, to ensure the full notification scope is achieved. This includes assisting and coordinating all materials, services, and resources, as well as establishing appropriate scheduling logic between individual operations and tasks to support the safe, efficient, and cost-effective delivery of projects across the OPA estate. Therefore, demonstrable experience of procurement processes is essential, ensuring the effective planning and management of materials so that they are ordered, delivered to site on time, and aligned with the overall project programme. There will be a need to build strong credible working relationships with all internal stakeholders, in particular other members of the project delivery team, operations, maintenance, HSSEQ department, procurement, and other discipline engineering colleagues. Travel to our UK sites will be a regular feature of this role, with some overnight stays. Therefore, a full (preferably clean) driving licence is essential for the successful candidate. There will also be occasional overseas travel when required. Responsibilities: Support the Minor New Works Manager and be the OPA Planning Lead for all Minor New Works project planning, providing leadership and guidance for planning / programming requirements. Ensure all activities are planned and executed in line with health, safety, and compliance requirements. Plan and schedule Minor New Works work orders using the computerised maintenance management system. Review maintenance requests, prioritise work and create detailed job plans. Maintain and update CMMS records, including asset information, inventory, and assurance schedules. Ensure job plans contain the following: Special instructions and planned documentation such as MOC information, QAQC needs, piping schematics etc., required skill crafts and duration, speciality tools or equipment, optional scheduling logic between operations and maintenance, reservation or purchase order for necessary components and forward them to the relevant parties. Participate in the management of notification and work order backlog by, reviewing backlog and planning list for duplicates, grouping notifications together that can be planned and worked as a single order that optimises utilisation resources, ensure plans are in place that meet the timing requirements to ensure effective project delivery. Prepare KPI reports and provide administrative support to the maintenance department. Full details of the responsibilities can be found in the job description for this role, which is available to download at the top of this advert. The candidate: We are looking for an experienced planning professional with a strong background in engineering, infrastructure, maintenance, or major hazard environments, ideally qualified in a relevant engineering discipline, or be qualified by experience within a planning, shutdown, or project function. You will have a proven track record of operating within structured project management frameworks and procedures, with the ability to lead planning activities across multiple projects and sites. Experience acting as a Planning Lead is essential, providing expert guidance and direction on planning, programming, scheduling, and progress monitoring to ensure successful project delivery. The successful candidate will need to have experience in using Primavera P6 or similar planning software, and be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook, and comfortable utilising Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) such as SAP, Maximo, or equivalent systems. A sound understanding of engineering principles is required, including the ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. Experience supporting plant shutdowns, turnarounds, or major maintenance activities would be advantageous. Experience within Major Accident Hazard (MAH) or similarly regulated environments is essential, together with a working knowledge of COMAH, Management of Change (MOC), and CDM Regulations. Stage 1 Interviews: 1 December 2026 (By Teams) Stage 2 Interviews: 10 December 2026 (Face to Face, Location Tbc) The Organisation The Oil & Pipelines Agency is a Public Corporation formed by the Oil and Pipelines Act 1985. Our current primary purpose is to manage, operate and maintain 6 Naval OFD’s (Oil Fuel Depots) and 1 Petroleum Storage Depot in the UK, as well as overseas, on behalf of the MOD. We currently have around 200 employees in the UK.
